verdicts.reason: A shrinks the whole portrait layout into a tiny column in the middle of the banner. The headline, body, badges and CTA are all unreadable specks, and the rest of the strip is empty dark space. B does rearrange for the banner shape: headline on the left, then the LIMITED EDITION badge and an orange CTA on the right. But its four-line headline is crammed and tiny, the product can and logo are lost or microscopic, the AWARD WINNING 2026 badge competes with the CTA, and the elements sit hard against the edges with no breathing room.
